from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """One paper from the provided collection, identifying its title and which other provided papers it cites."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The exact title of this paper as it appears in the document")
    cites_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of other provided papers that appear in this paper's reference list")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Container for all extracted papers to enable chain construction."""
    papers: list[Paper]
